query: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, COUNT(m.id) as message_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN messages m ON u.id = m.recipientId WHERE u.email LIKE '%mentor%' OR u.email LIKE '%mentee%' GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.name;
